definition: Robby Garner (born 1963) is an American natural language programmer and software developer.
details: He won the 1998 and 1999 Loebner Prize contests with the program called Albert One. He is listed in the 2001 Guinness Book of World Records as having written the "most human" computer program.

explainer.lead: Robby Garner is an American natural language programmer and software developer.

timeline.what: Forming a software company called Robitron Software Research, Inc. in 1987 with his father, Robert J. Garner, and his sister Pam, he worked as a software developer until 1997 when he moved to Cedartown.

A spin-off of this technique is the Turing Hub, Garner's current work ( 2009, 2010, 2014) focuses on text-only communications and the use of film theory to facilitate story telling, and identification of emotions in human beings.
